scope: Official ClinicalTrials.gov latest completed interventional DRUG Phase I-IV scope, exact actual observed completion dates; no historical exposed IDs
source_contract: Parent acquisition preserves raw responses, hashes, request provenance and excludes union of all historical source/manifest IDs. Baseline provenance is false. No source snapshot availability is inferred from start dates.

split.purge: training completion before validation cutoff; original validation completion before test cutoff
split.calibration: later half of retained validation date groups when at least10 rows; otherwise unavailable
split.phase: whole date60/20/20; no outcome purge; phase label availability retrospective

selection.new_duration_candidates: minimum tuning MAE then RMSE then declared grid order
selection.duration_champion: minimum tuning MAE then RMSE then model name
selection.risk: minimum raw tuning Brier then model name
selection.phase: maximum tuning macro-F1 then balanced accuracy then model name; includes majority
selection.test: evaluate once; never tune, refit, recalibrate or choose by final test

duration_candidates.design_task_selected: independent duration/risk selection among all enabled fitted legacy/new candidates; no extra fitting

features.phase: remove phase categorical and any target-derived field; phase text uses existing explicit phase redaction
features.planned_enrollment: source ESTIMATED only; never substitute ACTUAL/current enrollment
features.retrospective_descriptors: site/country/counts are current reported descriptors, not demonstrated planned/baseline inputs
features.preprocessing: fit imputers, missing indicators, scaling, one-hot categories and vocabulary only on training

evaluation.interpretation: conditional fitted-model trial bootstrap; no fitting/clustering uncertainty correction
evaluation.calibration: sigmoid on reserved calibration only if class support permits; raw/calibrated distinct
evaluation.intervals: 90% split-conformal; report empirical coverage, no future coverage guarantee

endpoint: duration completion minus start; risk strictly above new training75th percentile. New threshold is recorded and cannot be compared as identical binary endpoint to old1101-day model unless explicitly harmonized.
promotion: No automatic catalog or project activation. Previously inspected64/59 tests are historical only. Matched new-cohort legacy/new candidates provide the primary comparison. Honest gain/loss/inconclusive reporting.
